observations: Photo 0 shows a UPS with the text/logo “BLUE GATE” on the front panel and a blue vertical status/control area with a power button.
Photo 1 shows the UPS from an angle with the “BLUE GATE” branding visible on the side/front; two-pin plug/cables are visible at the top.
No photo shows the battery compartment, battery brand/spec label, or any runtime/load test results.

claims.evidence: Photos show a UPS unit branded “BLUE GATE” (photo 0, photo 1).
No photo of battery label/date, battery compartment, or proof of replacement.
No runtime test photo/clip; no load specification (wattage/connected device) shown.
No internal/battery compartment photos, no inspection of seals/screws, and no service history shown.

risks.risk: Battery capacity may be overstated; runtime could be much shorter than claimed, especially under load.
risks.proof: A video/clip showing the UPS powering a known load (e.g., a specified wattage bulb/fan or small appliance) with a timer from start to shutdown.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven for long runtime (worst case: treat as faulty/weak battery comparable).

risks.risk: UPS may not switch to battery correctly (transfer fault) or may have weak inverter output.
risks.proof: A clip showing mains unplugged while the UPS continues powering the load, plus the UPS status LEDs during transfer.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working reliably (worst case: faulty UPS comparable).

risks.risk: Capacity/ratings (VA/W) are unknown; could be a smaller unit than expected, affecting value.
risks.proof: Photo of the rating label (VA/W, input/output, battery voltage) on the back/bottom.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lower end for generic Blue Gate UPS units (worst case: smallest/weakest).

risks.risk: “Never repaired” may be false; unit could have been opened/rewired or have worn components.
risks.proof: Photo of opened battery compartment or close-up of internal wiring/condition and any warranty/seal marks (if present).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially repaired/used (worst case: faulty comparable).

proof_requests: Photo of the UPS rating label (VA/W, input/output, battery voltage) on the back/bottom.
Video test: connect a known wattage load, unplug mains, show UPS stays on and record runtime until shutdown.
Photo of the battery compartment/battery label (brand, voltage, date) or a receipt/receipt-like proof of replacement.
response.reason: The photos clearly show a BLUE GATE UPS, but the key value claims (new battery, 8-hour runtime, never repaired) are not provable from the images. So it should be priced at the worst case consistent with the available comparables (faulty/weak).
